summary: Bounded authorized gossip and isolated peer tests

delivery.outcome: Explicitly authorized bounded peer synchronization with staged package import and reproducible isolated node tests
nonGoals: Replacing the Taskand catalog/schema in this slice

architecture.decision: One existing gossip worker; configured peers are authority, learned peers are observations; peer-scoped credentials, bounded transport, serialized rounds, candidate-only default, content conflicts surfaced and staged imports. Paxlet remains the target shared package contract.
interfaceChanges: Gossip requires operation grants and peer-scoped credential configuration
Gossip status reports bounded discovery/conflicts/partial failures
Federation rejects redirects, oversized or inconsistent packages and installs atomically
architecture.rollback: Disable TASKAND_GOSSIP_ENABLED and clear TASKAND_PEERS; revert implementation if needed; imported packages remain candidates and existing data is preserved

validation.evidence: Exact-head local reports and isolated peer test receipts
